TraceProtocol DEFINITIONS AUTOMATIC TAGS ::=
BEGIN
TraceMessage ::= CHOICE {
    startSession            StartSession,
    stopSession             StopSession,
    startRecordingSession   StartRecordingSession,
    stopRecordingSession    StopRecordingSession,
    report                  Report,
    alive                   IsAlive,
    configure               Configure,
    ...
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  StartSession msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
StartSession  ::= SEQUENCE {
    seqNum          SequenceNumber,
    sourceId        SynchronizationSourceId,
    enb-Id          Global-eNB-Id,
    traceReference  TraceReference,
    cellId          CellGlobalIdEUTRA OPTIONAL,
    timestamp       UTC-Timestamp,
    sessionConfig   SessionConfig,
    enb-Info        ENB-Info,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  StopSession msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
StopSession  ::= SEQUENCE {
    seqNum          SequenceNumber,
    sourceId        SynchronizationSourceId,
    enb-Id          Global-eNB-Id,
    traceReference  TraceReference,
    cellId          CellGlobalIdEUTRA OPTIONAL,
    timestamp       UTC-Timestamp,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  StartRecordingSession msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
StartRecordingSession  ::= SEQUENCE {
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    sourceId                    SynchronizationSourceId,
    enb-Id                      Global-eNB-Id OPTIONAL,
    traceReference              TraceReference,
    traceRecordingSessionRef    TraceRecordingSessionRef,
    cellId                      CellGlobalIdEUTRA OPTIONAL,
    cellType                    CellType OPTIONAL,
    recordInitSeqNum            SequenceNumber,
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  StopRecordingSession msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
StopRecordingSession  ::= SEQUENCE {
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    sourceId                    SynchronizationSourceId,
    enb-Id                      Global-eNB-Id OPTIONAL,
    traceReference              TraceReference,
    traceRecordingSessionRef    TraceRecordingSessionRef,
    cellId                      CellGlobalIdEUTRA OPTIONAL,
    recordEndSeqNum             SequenceNumber,
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  Report msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
Report  ::= SEQUENCE {
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    sourceId                    SynchronizationSourceId,
    enb-Id                      Global-eNB-Id,
    traceReference              TraceReference,
    cellId                      CellGlobalIdEUTRA OPTIONAL,
    recordList                  RecordList,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  IsAlive msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
IsAlive  ::= SEQUENCE {
    enb-Id                      Global-eNB-Id,
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {} OPTIONAL
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  Configure msg
--
-- ****************************************************************************
Configure ::= SEQUENCE {
    enb-Id              Global-eNB-Id,
    version             Version,
    futureExtension SEQUENCE {}
}

-- ****************************************************************************
--  Types
-- ****************************************************************************

ASN1-Data ::= SEQUENCE {
    asn1-MsgId      ASN1-MsgId,
    asn1-Payload    ASN1-PayloadContainer
}

ASN1-MsgId ::= INTEGER (0..65535)

ASN1-PayloadContainer ::= OCTET STRING

AngleOfArrival ::= INTEGER(0..719)

AvgBsr ::= INTEGER(0..63)

AvgNumberOfSchPrb ::= INTEGER(0..100)

BytesCount ::= INTEGER(0..MAX)

-- 36.331
CellGlobalIdEUTRA ::= SEQUENCE {
    plmn-Identity   PLMN-Identity,
    cellIdentity    CellIdentity
}

CellIdentity ::= BIT STRING (SIZE (28))

C-RNTI ::= BIT STRING (SIZE (16))

-- format: Q4.10
DeltaCQI ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2))

Direction ::= ENUMERATED {ul, dl, none}

DlUeThroughputMeasurements ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker                   BOOLEAN,
    dataCollectionDuration      TTIsCount,
    sumOfSentNonGbrBytes        BytesCount,
    sumOfSentGbrBytes           BytesCount,
    maxGbrDelay                 MillisecondsDelay,
    numOfSingleCWTx             TransmissionsCount,
    numOfSingleCW1stTx          TransmissionsCount,
    numOfSingleCW1stTxFailed    TransmissionsCount,
    numOfSingleCWLastTxFailed   TransmissionsCount,
    numOfDualCWTx               TransmissionsCount,
    numOfDualCW1stTx            TransmissionsCount,
    numOfDualCW1stTxFailed      TransmissionsCount,
    numOfDualCWLastTxFailed     TransmissionsCount,
    pdcchDtx                    TransmissionsCount,
    numOfTtiPositiveDlBuf       TTIsCount,
    meanDeltaCqi                DeltaCQI,
    meanLaWbCqi                 WidebandCQI,
    ...
}

ENB-Id ::= CHOICE {
    macro-eNB-Id    BIT STRING (SIZE (20)),
    home-eNB-Id     BIT STRING (SIZE (28)),
    ...
}

ENB-Info ::= SEQUENCE {
    enb-SwRelease               ENB-SwRelease,
    enb-Type                    ENB-Type,
    threeGppReleaseSupported    ThreeGppReleaseSupported,
    timezone-min                INTEGER,
    ...
}

ENB-SwRelease ::= ENUMERATED {
    xL17,
    ...,
    xL17SP,
    xL17A,
    xL17ASP,
    xL18,
    xL18SP,
    xL18A,
    xL19,
    xL19A,
    xL19B,
    xL20A,
    xL20B,
    xL20C,
    xL21A,
    xL21B,
    x22R1,
    x22R2,
    x22R3
}

ENB-Type ::= ENUMERATED {
    macroFDD,
    macroTDD,
    microFDD,
    microTDD,
    controllerFDD,
    controllerTDD,
    picoFDD,
    picoTDD,
    ...
}

ENB-UE-S1AP-Id ::= INTEGER (0..16777215)

-- 36.413 9.2.1.37
-- 36.423 9.2.22
Global-eNB-Id ::= SEQUENCE {
    plmn-Identity   PLMN-Identity,
    enb-Id          ENB-Id
}

GUMMEI ::= SEQUENCE {
    plmn-Identity   PLMN-Identity,
    mme-GroupId     MME-GroupId,
    mme-Code        MME-Code
}

MCSIndex ::= INTEGER(0..255)

MillisecondsDelay ::= INTEGER(0..65535)

MME-Code ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (1))

MME-GroupId ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2))

MME-UE-S1AP-Id ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

PhysCellId ::= INTEGER (0..503)

-- 36.413, 36.423
PLMN-Identity ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (3))

-- 36.133
PowerHeadroom ::= INTEGER(0..63)

PowerHeadroom-dB  ::= INTEGER(-23..40)

Record ::= SEQUENCE {
    traceRecordingSessionRef    TraceRecordingSessionRef OPTIONAL,
    sourceId                    SynchronizationSourceId,
    seqNum                      SequenceNumber,
    -- Note: timestamps can be not monotonic
    timestamp                   UTC-Timestamp,
    crnti                       C-RNTI OPTIONAL,
    enb-ue-s1ap-Id              ENB-UE-S1AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    mme-ue-s1ap-Id              MME-UE-S1AP-Id OPTIONAL,
    gummei                      GUMMEI OPTIONAL,
    direction                   Direction DEFAULT none,
    data CHOICE {
        asn1-Data               ASN1-Data,
        vendorExtensionData     VendorExtensionRecordData
    },
    ...
}

RecordList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE (0..maxRecords)) OF Record

RICount ::= INTEGER (0..4294967295)

RIReport ::= SEQUENCE {
    ri1Count RICount,
    ri2Count RICount,
    ri3Count RICount,
    ri4Count RICount
}

RlfCauseInd ::= ENUMERATED {
    outOfSyncDetected,
    inSyncDetected,
    dlHarqFailureDetected,
    dlHarqFailureCleared,
    permanentOutOfSync,
    cqiReportFailureDetected,
    cqiReportFailureCleared,
    ulTransmissionFailureDetected,
    ulTransmissionFailureCleared,
    srsFailureDetected,
    srsFailureCleared,
    ...
}

RSSI-dBm ::= INTEGER(-120..-70)

SessionConfig ::= SEQUENCE {
    tce-IP-Address              TraceCollectionEntityIP-Address,
    asn1-MsgRecordList          BIT STRING,
    vendorExtensionRecordList   BIT STRING,
    ...,
    [[
    jobType                     JobType
    ]]
}

SequenceNumber ::= INTEGER (0..65535)

SINR-dB ::= INTEGER(-10..40)

SynchronizationSourceId ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2))

ThreeGppReleaseSupported ::= ENUMERATED {
    rel13,
    ...,
    rel14,
    rel15,
    rel16
}

TimingAdvance ::= INTEGER(0..65535)

TraceCollectionEntityIP-Address ::= BIT STRING (SIZE(1..160, ...))

-- 36.331
TraceReference ::= SEQUENCE {
    plmn-Identity   PLMN-Identity,
    traceId         OCTET STRING (SIZE (3))
}

TraceRecordingSessionRef ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (2))

TransmissionsCount ::= INTEGER(0..65535)

TTIsCount ::= INTEGER(0..65535)

UTC-Timestamp ::= SEQUENCE {
    seconds     INTEGER (0..4294967295),
    useconds    INTEGER (0..4294967295)
}

-- range index
Ul-SINR ::= INTEGER(0..36)

UlUeThroughputMeasurements ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker                   BOOLEAN,
    dataCollectionDuration      TTIsCount,
    sumOfReceivedNonGbrBytes    BytesCount,
    sumOfReceivedGbrBytes       BytesCount,
    maxGbrDelay                 MillisecondsDelay,
    numOfReceivedTx             TransmissionsCount,
    numOfReceived1stTx          TransmissionsCount,
    numOfFailed1stTx            TransmissionsCount,
    numOfFailedLastTx           TransmissionsCount,
    numOfTtiPositiveUlBuf       TTIsCount,
    meanMCS                     MCSIndex,
    meanPuschRssi               RSSI-dBm,
    meanPuschSinr               SINR-dB,
    meanPhr                     PowerHeadroom-dB,
    meanPucchRssi               RSSI-dBm,
    meanPdcchAggUl              INTEGER(0..255),
    meanPdcchAggDl              INTEGER(0..255),
    ...
}

VendorExtensionRecordData ::= CHOICE {
    timingAdvance               TimingAdvance,
    rlfCauseInd                 RlfCauseInd,
    synchTimingAdvance          TimingAdvance,
    powerHeadroom               PowerHeadroom,
    angleOfArrival              AngleOfArrival,
    ul-sinr                     Ul-SINR,
    riReport                    RIReport,
    puschAvgNumberOfSchPrb      AvgNumberOfSchPrb,
    pdschAvgNumberOfSchPrb      AvgNumberOfSchPrb,
    avgBsr                      AvgBsr,
    ulUeThroughputMeasurements  UlUeThroughputMeasurements,
    dlUeThroughputMeasurements  DlUeThroughputMeasurements,
    rrcSetupRecord              RrcSetupRecord,
    ueSetupRecord               UeSetupRecord,
    ueReleaseRecord             UeReleaseRecord,
    ulRbSchedulingRecord        UlRadioBearerSchedulingTraceRecord,
    dlRbSchedulingRecord        DlRadioBearerSchedulingTraceRecord,
    ulRbRlcThroughputRecord     UlRadioBearerRlcThroughputRecord,
    dlRbRlcThroughputRecord     DlRadioBearerRlcThroughputRecord,
    dlRbPdcpThroughputRecord    DlRadioBearerPdcpThroughputTraceRecord,
    caRlcThroughputRecord       CaRlcThroughputTraceRecord,
    rtdRecord                   RtdTraceRecord,
    ulSchedulingRecord          UlSchedulingTraceRecord,
    dlSchedulingRecord          DlSchedulingTraceRecord,
    ...,
    x2HoSrcRecord               X2HoSrcTraceRecord,
    x2HoTgtRecord               X2HoTgtTraceRecord,
    s1HoSrcRecord               S1HoSrcTraceRecord,
    s1HoTgtRecord               S1HoTgtTraceRecord,
    ueMeasTraceRecord           UeMeasTraceRecord,
    intra-enb-HoSrcRecord       Intra-eNB-HoSrcTraceRecord,
    intraCellHoSrcRecord        IntraCellHoSrcTraceRecord,
    bearerRecord                BearerTraceRecord,
    intra-enb-HoTgtRecord       Intra-eNB-HoTgtTraceRecord,
    rlfInfoRecord               RlfInfoTraceRecord,
    ueInfoRecord                UeInfoTraceRecord,
    intraCellHoTgtRecord        IntraCellHoTgtTraceRecord,
    ulLcgRecord                 UlLcgTraceRecord,
    ueCtxModificationRecord     UeCtxModificationTraceRecord,
    caConfigurationRecord       CaConfigurationTraceRecord,
    dlCaSCellUsageRecord        DlCaSCellUsageTraceRecord,
    dlCaSCellSchedulingRecord   DlCaSCellSchedulingTraceRecord,
    ripRecord                   RipTraceRecord,
    sgnbAdditionRecord          SgNBAdditionTraceRecord,
    menbInitiatedSgNBModRecord  MeNBInitiatedSgNBModificationTraceRecord,
    sgnbInitiatedSgNBModRecord  SgNBInitiatedSgNBModificationTraceRecord,
    menbInitiatedSgNBRelRecord  MeNBInitiatedSgNBReleaseTraceRecord,
    sgnbInitiatedSgNBRelRecord  SgNBInitiatedSgNBReleaseTraceRecord,
    riMonitoringRecord          RiMonitoringTraceRecord,
    sgnbChangeRecord            SgNBChangeTraceRecord,
    bearerRecord-r2             BearerTraceRecord-r2,
    riSlopeMeasRecord           RiSlopeMeasTraceRecord
}

RrcSetupRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    rrcConnReqTriggerTime       UTC-Timestamp,
    establishmentCause          RrcConnEstablishmentCause,
    s-tmsi                      S-TMSI OPTIONAL,
    rrcConnSetupCmplRcvTime     UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    result                      RrcSetupResult,
    ...
}

RrcConnEstablishmentCause ::= ENUMERATED {
    other,
    emergency,
    highPriorityAccess,
    mtAccess,
    moSignalling,
    moData,
    delayTolerantAccess,
    moVoiceCall,
    ...
}

RrcSetupResult ::= ENUMERATED {
    success,
    otherFailure,
    internalFailure,
    cacFailureOther,
    cacFailureL3CapacityExceeded,
    cacFailureMaxRrcConnectionsReached,
    cacFailureMaxPucchResourcesReached,
    deprioritisationUponCacFailure,
    enbOverloadCausedFailure,
    mmeOverloadCausedFailure,
    noResponseFromUe,
    rrcConnSetupCmplCorrupted,
    ...,
    repeatedRachAttemptCausedFailure,
    cacFailurePreemptionFailed,
    essentialCatMSibOnlineChange
}

S-TMSI ::= SEQUENCE {
    mme-Code    MME-Code,
    m-tmsi      M-TMSI
}

M-TMSI ::= OCTET STRING (SIZE (4))

UeSetupRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    setupReason             UeSetupReason,
    icsSetupReqRcvTime      UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    icsSetupCmplSndTime     UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    rrcConnReestReqRcvTime  UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    dl-CarrierFreq          EARFCN OPTIONAL,
    csfbRequested           CsfbRequestMarker,
    ...,
    [[
    qci-1-MutingTimeCase        QCI-1-MutingTimeCase OPTIONAL,
    rrcConnReconfCmplRcvTime    UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL
    ]]
}

EARFCN ::= INTEGER (0..262143)

UeSetupReason ::= ENUMERATED {
    other,
    rrcSetup,
    rrcReestInServingCell,
    rrcReestX2HoTgtInTgtCel,
    rrcReestS1HoTgtInTgtCell,
    rrcReestIntraeNBHoTgtInTgtCell,
    x2Ho,
    s1Ho,
    intraeNBHo,
    intraCellHo,
    interRatHo,
    rlfTriggeredIntraeNBHo,
    rlfTriggeredX2Ho,
    rrcReest,
    ...,
    connEstInd
}

QCI-1-MutingTimeCase ::= ENUMERATED {
    case1,
    case2,
    case3,
    ...
}

UeReleaseRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    classifier              CallFinalClassifier,
    rrcConnRelSndTime       UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    ueCtxRelCmplSndTime     UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL,
    redirectInfo            RedirectInfo OPTIONAL,
    ...,
    [[
    cellConfig              CellConfig,
    qci-1-MutingTimeCase    QCI-1-MutingTimeCase OPTIONAL,
    drxUsageTime            DrxUsageTime-ms OPTIONAL,
    ueCtxReleaseRcvTime     UTC-Timestamp OPTIONAL
    ]]
}

DrxUsageTime-ms ::=  INTEGER(0..4294967295,...)

CellConfig ::= SEQUENCE {
    gracefulCellShutdownInEffect    BOOLEAN,
    cellRangeExtensionActivated     BOOLEAN,
    sib8SyncModeInd                 Sib8SyncModeInd,
    ...
}

Sib8SyncModeInd ::= ENUMERATED {
    syncMode,
    aSyncMode,
    systemTimeInfoNotIncluded,
    sib8NotBroadcasted,
    ...
}

CsfbRequestMarker ::= ENUMERATED {
    none,
    emergency,
    nonEmergency
}

CallFinalClassifier ::= SEQUENCE {
    finalClass          CallFinalClass,
    primaryQualifier    CallFinalClassPrimaryQualifier,
    secondaryQualifier  CallFinalClassSecondaryQualifier
}

CallFinalClass ::= ENUMERATED {
    normal,
    intraeNBMobility,
    reestablishment,
    connDrop,
    icsFailure,
    ...
}

CallFinalClassPrimaryQualifier ::= ENUMERATED {
    none,
    mmeInitiated,
    enbInitiated,
    intereNBX2Ho,
    intereNBS1Ho,
    blindRedirectToEhrpd,
    measRedirectToUtraFdd,
    blindRedirectToUtraFdd,
    blindRedirectToGeran,
    other,
    psHoToUtra,
    ccoToGeran,
    measRedirectIntraLteInterFreqToSameFrameStruct,
    blindRedirectIntraLteInterFreqToSameFrameStruct,
    srvccToUtraHo,
    measRedirectIntraLteInterFreqToOtherFrameStruct,
    blindRedirectIntraLteInterFreqToOtherFrameStruct,
    dualRxCsfbTo1xRtt,
    blindRedirectTo1xRtt,
    measCsfbTo1xRtt,
    srvccToGeran,
    measRedirectToUtraTdd,
    srvccTo1xRtt,
    intraeNBIntraCellHo,
    intraeNBInterCellHo,
    noHo,
    intraeNBHo,
    intereNBHoSrc,
    unpreparedCell,
    noReestReqRcvFromUe,
    reestFailure,
    intraLteHoFailure,
    reestFailureIntraLteHo,
    abnormalReleaseAtTgt,
    abnormalReleaseByMme,
    cacFailure,
    timeout,
    securityActivationFailure,
    rrcConnReest,
    integrityFailure,
    securityAlgoNotCompatible,
    csfbOrGeranNotPossible,
    idleUe1xCsfbFailure,
    ...,
    connReleasedDueToPreemption,
    reestRejectDueToCatMSibMod,
    releaseDueToCatMSibMod
}

CallFinalClassSecondaryQualifier ::= ENUMERATED {
    none,
    intraFreqHo,
    interFreqHoToSameFrameStruct,
    eventA2ThresholdRSRP,
    eventA2ThresholdRSRQ,
    eventB2Threshold1RSRPThreshold2RSCP,
    eventB2Threshold1RSRPThreshold2EcNO,
    eventB2Threshold1RSRQThreshold2RSCP,
    eventB2Threshold1RSRQThreshold2EcNO,
    eventB1ThresholdRSCP,
    eventB1ThresholdEcNO,
    eventA2Threshold1RSRP,
    eventA2Threshold1RSRQ,
    eventB1EventB2TimerExpiration,
    other,
    eventB2Threshold1RSRPThreshold2GERAN,
    eventB2Threshold1RSRQThreshold2GERAN,
    eventA3ThresholdRSRP,
    eventA5ThresholdRSRP,
    eventA5ThresholdRSRQ,
    intraCell,
    interCell,
    x2Ho,
    s1Ho,
    timeoutRrcConnReest,
    timeoutRrcConnReconf,
    newRrcConnReestReq,
    radioLinkFailure,
    shortMaciMismatch,
    cacFailure,
    integrityFailure,
    messageMissing,
    capacityLicensingExceeded,
    noRadioResource,
    timeoutRrcConnReconfCmpl,
    timeoutSecurityModeProc,
    timeoutUeCapabilityInquiry,
    forbiddenRat,
    featureOff,
    interFreqHoToOtherFrameStruct,
    eventA3ThresholdRSRQ,
    rekeying,
    keNBRefresh,
    ttiBundlingActivation,
    ttiBundlingDeactivation,
    rrcReconfForPucch,
    periodic,
    normalRelease,
    detach,
    duringHo,
    notDuringHo,
    doubleS1,
    unspecifiedCause,
    authenticationFailure,
    eventB2,
    tooLateeNBResponse,
    internalFailure,
    ...,
    ueInactivityDueToReleaseAssistanceIndication
}

RedirectInfo ::= SEQUENCE {
    redirectType    RedirectType,
    ...,
    [[
    mobilityReason      RedirectMobilityTriggerReason,
    iRatSystemInfoSet   BOOLEAN
    ]]
}

RedirectType ::= ENUMERATED {
    eutra,
    geran,
    utraFdd,
    utraTdd,
    hrpd,
    oneXRtt,
    ...
}

RedirectMobilityTriggerReason ::= ENUMERATED {
    radioCondition,
    csfb,
    ...
}

WidebandCQI ::= INTEGER(0..255)

DRB-Id ::= INTEGER(1..32)

UlRadioBearerSchedulingTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    rbData SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF RadioBearerSchedulingData,
    ...
}

RadioBearerSchedulingData ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker                           BOOLEAN,
    drb-Id                              DRB-Id,
    dataCollectionDuration              TTIsCount,
    numOfTtiUnsatisfiedMinRateNonGbr    TTIsCount,
    ...
}

DlRadioBearerSchedulingTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    rbData SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF RadioBearerSchedulingData,
    ...
}

UlRadioBearerRlcThroughputRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    rbData SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF UlRadioBearerRlcThroughputData,
    ...
}

UlRadioBearerRlcThroughputData ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker               BOOLEAN,
    drb-Id                  DRB-Id,
    dataCollectionDuration  TTIsCount,
    numOfTtiUePduRcvd       TTIsCount,
    sumOfRlcPduTxBytes      BytesCount,
    sumOfRlcSduTxBytes      BytesCount,
    ...,
    [[
    residualBlerData        RadioBearerResidualBlerData OPTIONAL,
    delayHistogram          UlRadioBearerDelayHistogram OPTIONAL
    ]]
}

RadioBearerResidualBlerData ::= SEQUENCE {
    numOfBadRlcPduTx    TransmissionsCount,
    numOfRlcPduTx       TransmissionsCount
}

UlRadioBearerDelayHistogram ::= SEQUENCE {
    numOfPacketsGap1    PacketGapCount,
    numOfPacketsGap2    PacketGapCount,
    numOfPacketsGap3    PacketGapCount,
    numOfPacketsGap4    PacketGapCount
}

PacketGapCount ::= INTEGER(0..255)

DlRadioBearerRlcThroughputRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    rbData SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF DlRadioBearerRlcThroughputData,
    ...
}

DlRadioBearerRlcThroughputData ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker               BOOLEAN,
    drb-Id                  DRB-Id,
    dataCollectionDuration  TTIsCount,
    sumOf1stRlcPduTxBytes   BytesCount,
    sumOfRlcReTxBytes       BytesCount,
    numOfTtiRlcTx           TTIsCount,
    ...,
    [[
    delayHistogram          DlRadioBearerDelayHistogram OPTIONAL
    ]]
}

DlRadioBearerDelayHistogram ::= SEQUENCE {
    numOfPacketsGap1    PacketGapCount,
    numOfPacketsGap2    PacketGapCount,
    numOfPacketsGap3    PacketGapCount,
    numOfPacketsGap4    PacketGapCount
}

DlRadioBearerPdcpThroughputTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    rbData SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF DlRadioBearerPdcpThroughputData,
    ...
}

DlRadioBearerPdcpThroughputData ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker               BOOLEAN,
    drb-Id                  DRB-Id,
    dataCollectionDuration  TTIsCount,
    numOfPdcpPduRcvdForTx   INTEGER(0..MAX),
    numOfPdcpPduDiscarded   INTEGER(0..MAX),
    ...
}

CaRlcThroughputTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker                       BOOLEAN,
    recordCollectionDuration        TTIsCount,
    caActivationRlcTxBytes2Cc       BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcTxBytes3Cc       BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcTxBytes4Cc       BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcReTxBytes2Cc     BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcReTxBytes3Cc     BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcReTxBytes4Cc     BytesCount,
    ...,
    [[
    caActivationRlcTxBytes5Cc       BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcReTxBytes5Cc     BytesCount
    ]],
    [[
    caActivationRlcTxBytes6Cc       BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcTxBytes7Cc       BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcReTxBytes6Cc     BytesCount,
    caActivationRlcReTxBytes7Cc     BytesCount
    ]]
}

RtdTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    trigger         RTD-Trigger,
    value           RTD-Ts,
    ...
}

RTD-Trigger ::= ENUMERATED {
    rach,
    firstPuschTrans,
    distChange,
    ...
}

RTD-Ts ::= INTEGER(0..65535)

PRBsCount ::= INTEGER(0..MAX)

UlSchedulingTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker                       BOOLEAN,
    recordCollectionDuration        TTIsCount,
    numOfTtiUeSched                 TTIsCount,
    numOfPrbUsed                    PRBsCount,
    numOfHarq1stTx                  TransmissionsCount,
    numOfHarqReTx                   TransmissionsCount,
    numOfBad1stMacPduTx             TransmissionsCount,
    numOfBadLastMacPduTx            TransmissionsCount,
    avgSinr                         AvgSINR,
    avgPhr                          AvgPhr,
    ...
}

SamplesCount ::= INTEGER (0..65535)

AvgSINR ::= SEQUENCE {
    sumOfSinrSamples    INTEGER(0..MAX),

BearerTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    data CHOICE {
        setup       BearerSetupInfo,
        modify      BearerModifyInfo,
        release     BearerReleaseInfo
    },
    ...
}

BearerSetupInfo ::= SEQUENCE {
    erabSetupTime   ErabSetupTime-us OPTIONAL,
    bearers         BearerDataList,
    ...
}

ErabSetupTime-us ::=  INTEGER(0..60000000,...)

BearerDataList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF BearerData

BearerData ::= SEQUENCE {
    bearerIds   BearerIds,
    qci         QCI,
    arp         ArpSettings,
    gbrQosInfo  GbrQosInfo OPTIONAL,
    ...
}

BearerIds ::= SEQUENCE {
    erabId  ERAB-Id,
    drb-Id  DRB-Id
}

BitRate ::= INTEGER (0..10000000000)

ERAB-Id ::= INTEGER (0..15, ...)

QCI ::= INTEGER (0..255)

ArpSettings ::= SEQUENCE {
    priorityLevel               PriorityLevel,
    preemptionCapability        PreemptionCapability,
    preemptionVulnerability     PreemptionVulnerability,
    ...
}

PriorityLevel ::= INTEGER (0..15)

PreemptionCapability ::= ENUMERATED {
    shallNotTriggerPreemption,
    mayTriggerPreemption
}

PreemptionVulnerability ::= ENUMERATED {
    notPreemptable,
    preemptable
}

GbrQosInfo ::= SEQUENCE {
    ulGbr   BitRate,
    ...
}

BearerModifyInfo ::= SEQUENCE {
    bearers         BearerDataList,
    ...
}

BearerReleaseList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..maxNumOfBearers)) OF BearerIds

BearerReleaseInfo ::= SEQUENCE {
    bearers         BearerReleaseList,
    ...
}

    activationDurationWithVoIP                      TTIsCount,
    numOfActivations                                INTEGER(0..255),
    numOfActivationFailures                         INTEGER(0..255),
    numOfDeactivations                              INTEGER(0..255),
    numOfDeactivationsDueToInactivityTimerTimeout   INTEGER(0..255),
    numOfDeactivationsDueToDeconfiguration          INTEGER(0..255),
    numOfDeactivationsDueToUlRadioCriterion         INTEGER(0..255),
    ...,
    numOfDeactivationsDueToHarqFailure              INTEGER(0..255) OPTIONAL
}

DlCaSCellSchedulingTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    endMarker                       BOOLEAN,
    cellId  CHOICE {
        eci                         CellIdentity,
        ecgi                        CellGlobalIdEUTRA
    },
    recordCollectionDuration        TTIsCount,
    numOfTtiUeSched                 TTIsCount,
    numOfTtiUeSchedMimo             TTIsCount,
    numOfPrbUsed                    PRBsCount,
    numOfHarq1stTx                  TransmissionsCount,
    numOfHarqReTx                   TransmissionsCount,
    numOfBad1stMacPduTx             TransmissionsCount,
    numOfBadLastMacPduTx            TransmissionsCount,
    avgCodeword0MimoWbCqi           AvgWbCqi,
    avgCodeword1MimoWbCqi           AvgWbCqi,
    avgCodeword0NonMimoWbCqi        AvgWbCqi,
    ...
}

RipTraceRecord ::= SEQUENCE {
    bandwidth           BandwidthEUTRA,
    frameStructureInfo  FrameStructureInfo,
    ripData    CHOICE {
        rbData          RipRbTypeSubframeDataList,
        avgData         RipAvgTypeSubframeDataList
    },
    ...
}

BandwidthEUTRA ::= ENUMERATED {
    n6,
    n15,
    n25,
    n50,
    n75,
    n100
}

FrameStructureInfo ::= SEQUENCE {
    type        FrameStructureType,
    type2Info   FrameStructureType2Info OPTIONAL
}

FrameStructureType ::= ENUMERATED {
    type1,
    type2
}

FrameStructureType2Info ::= SEQUENCE {
    numOfNormalUlSubframes   INTEGER(1..6),
    numOfSpecialSubframes    INTEGER(1..2),
    numOfSymbolsForUpPTS     INTEGER(1..2)
}

RipRbTypeSubframeDataList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..20,...)) OF RipRbTypeSubframeData

RipRbTypeSubframeData ::= SEQUENCE {
    subframeIds     SubframeIdsType,
    ripRbValues     RipLevelList
}

SubframeIdsType ::= CHOICE {
    normal   NormalSubframeIds,
    special  SpecialSubframeIds
}

NormalSubframeIds ::= SEQUENCE {
    subframeNumber  SubframeNumber,
    slotNumber      SlotNumber
}

SubframeNumber ::= INTEGER(0..9)

SlotNumber ::= INTEGER(0..1)

SpecialSubframeIds ::= SEQUENCE {
    subframeNumber  SubframeNumber,
    symbolNumber    SymbolNumber
}

SymbolNumber ::= INTEGER(0..13)

RipLevelList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(6..100)) OF RipLevel

-- RIP level value range [0,511] (36.133), 0xFFFF used for not reported IE (currently PUCCH)
RipLevel ::= INTEGER(0..65535)

RipAvgTypeSubframeDataList ::= SEQUENCE (SIZE(1..20,...)) OF RipAvgTypeSubframeData

RipAvgTypeSubframeData ::= SEQUENCE {
    subframeIds     SubframeIdsType,
    ripAvgValue     RipLevel
}

JobType ::= ENUMERATED {
    traceOnly,
    immediateMDTOnly,
    immediateMDTAndTrace,
    rlfReportsOnly,
    spare4,
    spare3,
    spare2,
    spare1,
    ...
}
